_schema_note: Full-bleed three-quarter scene. Anchors resolve against this house's table in src/data/houses.json.

decoys.why: The fence is visibly damaged, and R-305 covers fence condition — but R-305 is NOT ACTIVE on Day 1. The binder is the authority on what is citable, not how bad something looks.

notes_for_designer: The hardest PASS of the day. The fence is collapsed into a debris pile — the most obviously wrong thing on the whole route — and it is not citable, because R-305 is not in the binder. If a player fails this lot they have stopped reading the rules. Plan is MIRRORED: the same art reflected, so the driveway and fence swap sides. Anchors reflect with it, so no second measurement is needed.
